title: enrich router
description: Sends a copy of the message along the outbound link with rule enrich, merges what comes out into the message and sends it on along the other link.

enrichType.title: Enrich type
enrichType.description: How the enrichment is merged: override (it replaces the message), xml (its root element is appended to the body's root element) or json (its members are set in the body's object)

enrichMethod.title: Enrich method
enrichMethod.description: Same as enrichType (an older name); it wins when both are set

enrichFileType.title: Enrich file type
enrichFileType.description: Same as enrichType (an older name); it wins over enrichType, and enrichMethod wins over it

useErrorRoute.title: Use error route
useErrorRoute.description: When the enrichment fails, fail the message (the flow's error route can take it); otherwise continue without the enrichment

attachmentName.title: Attachment name
attachmentName.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect (DIF has no attachments)
